subject: Vendor onboarding kickoff — Acme Corp procurement & PO process
messages:
From: Jordan Meyers <procurement@acme-acme.com>
To: Sean Gallagher <sean_gallagher@redwood.com>
Cc: Priya Rao <priya.rao@acme-acme.com>
Date: Sat, 28 Feb 2026 09:12:00 -0800
Subject: Redwood vendor setup & kickoff

Hi Sean,

Thanks for the quick intro last week. Procurement at Acme needs to get Redwood through our vendor setup and PO process before we can cut an SOW. Can we schedule a short kickoff to align on: vendor paperwork you need, PO/INVOICE flow, timeline to receive a vendor number, and any security evidence required for purchase?

Prefer next week AM PST. I can bring our Finance director (Priya Rao) if we need to confirm billing requirements.

Also attaching Acme's standard onboarding questionnaire — can you confirm which fields you need completed vs. what Redwood will supply?

Thanks,
Jordan

--
Jordan Meyers
Head of Procurement, Acme Corp
procurement@acme-acme.com
(555) 712-8802
(attachment: Acme-Vendor-Setup-Questionnaire.pdf)

From: Sean Gallagher <sean_gallagher@redwood.com>
To: Jordan Meyers <procurement@acme-acme.com>
Cc: Monica Patel <monica_patel@redwood.com>, Markus Klein <markus_klein@redwood.com>
Date: Sat, 28 Feb 2026 10:01:00 -08:00
Subject: Re: Redwood vendor setup & kickoff

Jordan — thanks, happy to run that. Proposed 30-min kickoff + a one-page MAP (mutual action plan) we can leave with Acme.

Proposed agenda (short):
- Introductions & success criteria (5 min)
- Vendor setup steps (required forms, tax/W9, bank info) (7 min)
- PO & invoicing workflow (how Acme issues POs, required PO fields, invoice cadence) (7 min)
- Security/compliance handoff (what evidence we can provide vs. what requires procurement signoff) (7 min)
- Next steps & owners (4 min)

I can do Monday 2026-03-02 9:30 AM PST or Tuesday 2026-03-03 10:00 AM PST. If neither works we can shift to an afternoon slot.

Attachments: Redwood-Vendor-Onboarding-Checklist.xlsx (high-level checklist), Redwood-PO-Instructions.pdf (sample invoice and remittance details).

Monica — looping you for any contract redline constraints; Markus — can you confirm finance needs for vendor banking/ACH?

Best,
Sean
Senior Account Executive | Redwood Inference
sean_gallagher@redwood.com | (415) 555-0199
(attachment: Redwood-Vendor-Onboarding-Checklist.xlsx, Redwood-PO-Instructions.pdf)

From: Monica Patel <monica_patel@redwood.com>
To: Sean Gallagher <sean_gallagher@redwood.com>
Cc: Jordan Meyers <procurement@acme-acme.com>, Markus Klein <markus_klein@redwood.com>
Date: Sat, 28 Feb 2026 11:40:00 -08:00
Subject: Re: Redwood vendor setup & kickoff

Sean / Jordan — quick notes from legal/ops perspective so we don't block the call:
- If Acme requires a PO before contract signature, we can accept a PO but need a short amendment to the MSA around effective dates.
- Standard Redwood payment terms are Net 30; Finance can support Net 45 on request, but need approval (Markus, can you confirm escalation path?).
- For security evidence: SOC 2 Type II report is available, plus a redacted architecture diagram. We'll answer questionnaire items marked as "Customer-supplied" and ask Acme to accept supplied docs by stamped acknowledgement.

Markus — please confirm whether Redwood needs Acme's vendor form completed for ACH setup or if a vendor portal submission is sufficient.

Monica
Head of Legal Ops | Redwood Inference
monica_patel@redwood.com
(attachment: none)

From: Jordan Meyers <procurement@acme-acme.com>
To: Sean Gallagher <sean_gallagher@redwood.com>
Cc: Priya Rao <priya.rao@acme-acme.com>, Monica Patel <monica_patel@redwood.com>
Date: Sat, 28 Feb 2026 13:04:00 -08:00
Subject: Re: Redwood vendor setup & kickoff

Sean — thanks, Tues 2026-03-03 10:00 AM PST works for us. Priya will join to confirm billing.

A couple quick asks before the call so we can move fast:
- Can you pre-fill the vendor name and tax ID on the Acme questionnaire where possible? That will shave ~20 minutes.
- Please include a single-line summary of the PO/invoice fields we require (PO number, billing contact, remit address, tax ID).
- If you have a DocuSign PO template or link we can use to speed up approvals, please share.

I appreciate the agenda — if we can leave the call with assigned owners and dates in the MAP, we should be set to route an internal PO the same week.

Jordan
